Albert Odyssey Gaiden - Legend of Eldean.name: Albert Odyssey: Legend of Eldean
Albert Odyssey Gaiden - Legend of Eldean.summary: Albert Odyssey: Legend of Eldean is a role-playing video game developed by Sunsoft for the Super Nintendo, but cancelled and ported to the Sega Saturn. It is the first Albert Odyssey title to be released in English, as well as the first to feature traditional turn-based role-playing elements as opposed to tactical, strategy-based gameplay. Legend of Eldean was created as a "gaiden", or sidestory to the original titles, and contains back story, characters, and plot that are independent from earlier games in the series. The North American version received generally favorable reviews, with the game's translation invoking mixed criticism both for its overly-humorous tone and departure from the original Japanese dialogue.

Pro Yakyuu Greatest Nine '98.name: Pro Yakyuu: Greatest Nine 98
Pro Yakyuu Greatest Nine '98.summary: Pro Yakyuu: Greatest Nine 98, is a baseball game for the Sega Saturn, sequel to Pro Yakyuu Greatest Nine 97.

Wing Arms.name: Wing Arms
Wing Arms.summary: Wing Arms is a blend of flight simulator and action game for the Sega Saturn, released in 1995. In an alternate history set after WWII, the player has to fight a multinational company which wants to prevent the war from ending.
